evidence.quote: With more than 1,000 cleaning specialists dedicated to its customers, IPC Group is active in over 120 countries to provide services and assistance, from pre-sales support to financial instruments, through to after-sales service. || IPC has four training centres in Italy, one for each Business Unit, where every year more than 5,000 hours of technical and commercial training are provided to our partners.
